map.温室通风量计算器，求所需通风量、换气次数与风口面积，保障作物生长环境并辅助通风系: Greenhouse ventilation rate calculator: finds the required ventilation rate, air changes and vent area to secure the crop growing environment and assist ventilation system selection.
map.体积 = 长 × 宽 × 平均高；通风量 = 体积 × 换气次数；秒通风量 =: Volume = length x width x average height; ventilation rate = volume x air changes; ventilation per second = ventilation rate / 3600; vent area = ventilation per second / (air speed x efficiency %)
map.所需通风量按「体积 × 目标换气次数」计算。风口面积由秒通风量除以「风速 × 风: The required ventilation rate is computed as 'volume x target air changes'. Vent area comes from ventilation per second divided by 'air speed x fan efficiency', and comparing it with floor area gives the vent area share (generally 15%-25% for natural ventilation). The number of fans is rounded up from a single-unit capacity of 35,000 m3/h, for ventilation system selection reference.
map.通风量 = 温室体积 × 目标换气次数（次/h）。: Ventilation rate = greenhouse volume x target air changes (per hour).
map.夏季降温 30~60 次/h，冬季除湿 1~3 次/h。: Summer cooling 30-60 times/h, winter dehumidification 1-3 times/h.
map.用于风机与湿帘、天窗设计选型。: For selecting fans, cooling pads and roof vents.
map.：温室体积 3000 m³，夏季需换气 50 次/h，通风量 = 3000×50: : Greenhouse volume 3000 m3, needing 50 air changes per hour in summer: ventilation rate = 3000 x 50 = 150,000 m3/h. Fit 3 fans of 50,000 m3/h plus cooling pads, and check the face velocity at 1.5-2.0 m/s.
map.湿帘和风机怎么配合？: How do pad and fan systems work together?
map.风机抽风、湿帘进风，形成负压流经湿帘降温。湿帘面积按设计过帘风速定，面积不足则阻: Fans draw air out while cooling pads let air in, creating negative pressure that pulls air through the pads for cooling. Pad area is set by the design face velocity; too little area means high resistance and poor cooling.
map.由目标温降与室外温湿度决定。湿热地区需更高换气并配合湿帘；干热地区仅靠通风即可。: Decided by the target temperature drop together with outside temperature and humidity. Humid-hot regions need higher air changes combined with cooling pads; dry-hot regions can rely on ventilation alone. Adjust by crop heat tolerance and season.
